name: Gansu Golden Glass Technologies Limited
summary: Gansu Golden Glass Technologies Limited, established in 1992 and based in Shantou, China, operates as an international manufacturer and provider of a wide array of glass products for the building sector. The company's offerings extend to cutting-edge photovoltaic (PV) systems, which include BIPV modules and cells, as well as specialized ultra-thin glass designed for improved thermal properties. Furthermore, they supply comprehensive security glass systems. These solutions feature steel profiles and integrated systems engineered for fire-resistant and blast-resistant curtain walls and partitions. Their protective glass range comprises tough fire-resistant glass, tough low-E fire-resistant glass, blast-resistant glass, and hurricane-resistant glass. Guard booths are also part of their security product line. In the realm of architectural glass, Gansu Golden Glass provides an extensive selection. This includes low-E tempered glass, heat-strengthened glass (with heat soak testing capabilities), curved tempered glass, laminated glass, insulated glass, enamelled tempered glass, and glass flooring products. They also specialize in high-precision processing for complex-shaped glass applications. The company previously traded as Guangdong Golden Glass Technologies Limited before undergoing a name change to Gansu Golden Glass Technologies Limited in April 2022.
